shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' app/UserDashboard.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,200p' package.json && sed -n '1,200p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,160p' next.config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs && git diff -- package.json && git log --oneline -5 && git show HEAD:package.json"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx && git show HEAD:app/UserDashboard.tsx && git show HEAD:app/page.tsx && test -d node_modules && echo node_modules-present || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- app/UserDashboard.tsx tsconfig.json package.json'
/bin/bash -lc "find .next -type f | wc -l; find .next -type d | wc -l; file next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; sed -n '1,40p' next-env.d.ts; wc -c tsconfig.tsbuildinfo"

/bin/bash -lc 'test ! -e next-env.d.ts && echo '"'next-env removed'; test "'! -e tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && echo '"'buildinfo removed'; find .next -depth -delete; git status --short; git diff --check; if git diff --quiet -- tsconfig.json; then echo 'tsconfig unchanged'; else echo 'tsconfig differs'; fi"
